label: post_outcome_diagnostic_not_clean_alpha_validation

headline.caveat: Historical replay remains current-model/search contaminated and is diagnostic rather than clean forward alpha validation.

frozenDecisionSummary.interpretation: Zero Primary was deliberate: V1.6 state-leading evidence was allowed to continue mapping but did not bypass V1.5 valuation, timing, company-quality or expectation gates.

researchResults.diagnosis: Both expressions beat the falling benchmark at 60d but lost money and lagged the frozen OEM control. Neutral late-reversal timing was a meaningful blocker; later 120d strength does not retroactively create a 60d Primary.

CATL delivered benchmark-relative strength, but BYD was stronger over the base horizon. Keeping a premium-valuation leader at Research avoided overclaiming company-specific asymmetry while still preserving the correct NEV direction.

V1.6 correctly preserved the low-inventory upstream state and continued company mapping, but chain offsets, finite duration and neutral timing kept the memo at Research. The later poor outcome supports keeping the causal-state test diagnostic rather than a promotion route.

The compliance state produced slight benchmark/matched-basket relative value, but the selected company did not beat the best frozen peer and absolute return was negative. Excluding the post-cutoff final A/B/C/D classification was correct.

positiveStateLeadCases.outcomeInterpretation: Bad outcome demonstrates anti-veto did not become an unsafe promotion shortcut.
Mechanism remained plausible but outcome is too weak/confounded by missing cutoff classification to validate positive state-leading recall.

negativeStateLeadCase.interpretation: V1.6 captured a non-agricultural leading state/flow structure while correctly refusing to invent a positive long A-share proxy.

pv.explanation: October 9 policy clarification and especially the November 2 solar-plan meeting were new information after cutoff; contemporaneous reporting linked the latter to a broad PV rally. Do not score the full 60d move as a clean September-30 discovery miss.

dram.explanation: The frozen state implication was negative for DRAM suppliers and no positive direct A-share DRAM long basket was frozen; no hindsight proxy substitution.

toolingAudit.fix: Post-lock diagnostic adapter forward-filled only internal suspension dates at prior close with zero volume, never synthesized entry dates, and retained raw prices plus a separate audit.
toolingAudit.recommendation: Port suspension-aware mark-to-market handling into future evaluator tooling with explicit non-executable-exit metadata, separately from skill semantics.

crossWindowInterpretation.2019Q2: V1.5 promotion safety held; issuer-specific corporate-action discovery blind spot identified.
crossWindowInterpretation.2019Q1: V1.5 base-horizon convexity received direct mechanism support on the 20d dye case.
crossWindowInterpretation.2018Q4: V1.5 selection discipline worked, while pork exposed the stock-flow lead-lag discovery failure that motivated V1.6.
crossWindowInterpretation.2018Q3: V1.6 did not overpromote state-leading signals, but this window does not yet provide a clean positive recall success case.

versionDecision.nextAction: Run unchanged V1.6 on another untouched window, preferably 2018Q2, and specifically look for a cutoff-valid positive upstream state that conflicts with a lagging downstream flow. Do not force such a case if none exists.
separateFutureWork: After causal-state validation, independently test the issuer-specific corporate-action discovery lane; do not mix both changes in one candidate.
Upstream the suspension-aware evaluator fix as tooling only, with tests for internal suspension, suspended entry and suspended exit.

prohibitedInferences: Do not claim V1.6 positive recall is validated from 2018Q3.
Do not promote state_leads_flow into an automatic buy route.
Do not use October steel classifications in the September 30 memo.
Do not classify the full PV 60d rally as a clean cutoff-valid miss.
Do not tune V1.6 on 2018Q3 outcomes.
